issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, but the reference implementation defines getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return int. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Update the UML and any references in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (and adjust the hint text accordingly), or alternatively change the implementation to return a String. Preferably change the UML to int so it matches the implementation and the intended numeric total.
